This '''black and yellow R2 unit''' was the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for the [[Aleph-class starfighter|''Aleph''-class starfighter]] that [[Syal Antilles]] and [[Zueb Zan]] flew in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] as part of [[Gray Squadron (Aleph-class)|Gray Squadron]].<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

==Biography==
The [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] was present for the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. It alerted Syal Antilles to various threats, including a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] lock on her fighter.<ref name="Betrayal" />

==Behind the scenes==
This droid made its first appearance in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series of novels, written by [[Aaron Allston]]. It appears on pages 319 and 402 of the novel.<ref name="Betrayal" /> It is never given a designation.

==Appearances==
*''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]'' {{1st}}
